settings.heading: Get in touch.
settings.text: Questions about a product, your order or delivery? We’re here to help.

settings.heading: We’re here to help.
settings.text: Send us a message and our team will get back to you. Including your order number helps us assist you faster.
settings.response_note: We aim to reply within 1–2 business days.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Your CLIMORA order will be delivered through our courier partner, Aramex. Estimated delivery is 5–10 business days, subject to order processing and courier collection.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: When your order is handed to Aramex you’ll receive a shipping confirmation email. When tracking is available for your shipment, the tracking details are included in that email.

settings.question: Can I return a product?
settings.answer: Yes, subject to our policy. See Returns & Refunds for eligibility, timeframes and how to start a return.
